nodes.speaker: eng
nodes.text: Touchdown in 10 seconds! The ground slopes about 9 degrees, near our landing legs' limit.

variants.text: Touchdown in 10 seconds! The ground slopes about 9 degrees, but we packed spare footpads.

nodes.fact: Landers are built for gentle slopes. Apollo's lander was designed to touch down on slopes of up to about 12 degrees.

nodes.speaker: eng
nodes.text: The lander has tilted about 10 degrees. It's stable, but the ramp and solar panels will be awkward.
nodes.fact: In 2024 the Odysseus lander tipped onto its side near the Moon's south pole, but it kept working for days.

nodes.speaker: aria
nodes.text: CONTACT LIGHT! Engines off. We are on the Moon, Commander.

variants.text: CONTACT LIGHT! Engines off. We are on the Moon, Commander. Earth's reply is faint and crackly.
CONTACT LIGHT! Engines off. We are on the Moon, and Earth's cheers come through crystal clear.
CONTACT LIGHT! Engines off. We are on the Moon. Earth's cheers arrive in crackly bursts.

nodes.fact: In 1969 Apollo 11 radioed: Houston, Tranquility Base here. The Eagle has landed.
